items.html: And behold, in the third year, the lower article of the Netzach of Tevunah enters, and within it the Sefira of Netzach of the Tzelem, and it enters within the Sefira of Chokhma of ZA, in the aspect of the Partzuf of VAK, as mentioned. And still the third article of the Hod of Tevunah remains above, like a person bending his leg upward, hanging. And in the fourth year, the Hod of the Tzelem, which is within the third article of the Hod of Tevunah, enters, and enters within the Bina of ZA.
